questions.question: Why did net flows in Sahyadri Credit Risk Fund drop in March 2024?

checks.detail: Tables: benchmark_values, benchmarks, folios, investors, nav_history, scheme_aum_monthly, scheme_plans, schemes, sip_registrations, transactions
transactions filtered by a range on txn_date

result.sql: WITH scheme_metrics AS (SELECT s.scheme_name, SUM(CASE WHEN t.txn_type IN ('Redemption', 'Switch Out') THEN -t.amount ELSE t.amount END) AS net_flows, COUNT(CASE WHEN t.txn_type = 'Redemption' THEN 1 END) AS redemptions, SUM(CASE WHEN t.txn_type = 'Redemption' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS redemption_value, AVG(CASE WHEN t.txn_status = 'Rejected' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END) * 100 AS rejection_rate, COUNT(CASE WHEN sr.sip_status = 'Cancelled' AND sr.cancelled_date BETWEEN '2024-02-01' AND '2024-03-31' THEN 1 END) AS sip_cancellations, nh.nav / nh_start.nav - 1 AS fund_return, bv.index_value / bv_start.index_value - 1 AS benchmark_return, sam.aum_amount AS aum FROM transactions t JOIN scheme_plans sp ON t.plan_id = sp.plan_id JOIN schemes s ON sp.scheme_id = s.scheme_id LEFT JOIN folios f ON t.folio_id = f.folio_id LEFT JOIN investors i ON f.investor_id = i.investor_id LEFT JOIN scheme_aum_monthly sam ON s.scheme_id = sam.scheme_id AND sam.month_end_date = '2024-03-31' LEFT JOIN nav_history nh ON sp.plan_id = nh.plan_id AND nh.nav_date = '2024-03-31' LEFT JOIN nav_history nh_start ON sp.plan_id = nh_start.plan_id AND nh_start.nav_date = '2024-02-01' LEFT JOIN benchmarks b ON s.benchmark_id = b.benchmark_id LEFT JOIN benchmark_values bv ON b.benchmark_id = bv.benchmark_id AND bv.value_date = '2024-03-31' LEFT JOIN benchmark_values bv_start ON b.benchmark_id = bv_start.benchmark_id AND bv_start.value_date = '2024-02-01' LEFT JOIN sip_registrations sr ON f.folio_id = sr.folio_id WHERE s.scheme_name = 'Sahyadri Credit Risk Fund' AND t.txn_date BETWEEN '2024-02-01' AND '2024-03-31' AND t.txn_status = 'Completed' GROUP BY s.scheme_name, sam.aum_amount, nh.nav, nh_start.nav, bv.index_value, bv_start.index_value) SELECT scheme_name, ROUND(net_flows, 2) AS net_flows, redemptions, ROUND(redemption_value, 2) AS redemption_value, ROUND(rejection_rate, 2) AS rejection_rate, sip_cancellations, ROUND(fund_return, 2) AS fund_return, ROUND(benchmark_return, 2) AS benchmark_return, ROUND(aum, 2) AS aum FROM scheme_metrics
result.commentary: The Sahyadri Credit Risk Fund saw a significant drop in net flows over the past four months. In March 2024, net flows were negative at -14.57 lakh, alongside 27 redemptions totaling 30.90 lakh. The preceding month showed net flows of -10.84 crore with 116 redemptions worth 17.26 crore. In the month before that, net flows were -10.08 crore with 85 redemptions totaling 16.32 crore. The fund's Assets Under Management (AUM) remained at 197.62 crore across these months. There were no SIP cancellations or rejections recorded.

expected.question: Why did net flows in Sahyadri Credit Risk Fund drop in March 2024?
expected.notes: Redemptions spike after the Vardhaman bond is cut to BBB- on 12 Mar 2024.

questions.question: Which scheme has the highest exposure to a single business group?

checks.detail: Tables: issuer_groups, issuers, portfolio_holdings, schemes, securities

result.sql: SELECT ph.scheme_id, sc.scheme_name, ig.group_name, SUM(ph.weight_pct) AS group_exposure FROM portfolio_holdings ph JOIN securities s ON ph.security_id = s.security_id JOIN issuers i ON s.issuer_id = i.issuer_id JOIN issuer_groups ig ON i.group_id = ig.group_id JOIN schemes sc ON ph.scheme_id = sc.scheme_id GROUP BY ph.scheme_id, sc.scheme_name, ig.group_name ORDER BY group_exposure DESC LIMIT 1
result.commentary: The Sahyadri Mid Cap Fund has the highest exposure to a single business group, with an exposure of 1440 lakh rupees to the Trident Group. This is the only scheme identified with the highest exposure in the data provided.

expected.notes: Mid Cap Fund holds about 24% across five Trident Group companies.

questions.question: Did the Focused Fund perform better after its manager changed in October 2023?

result.sql: WITH fund_nav AS (SELECT nav_history.nav_date, nav_history.nav FROM nav_history JOIN scheme_plans ON nav_history.plan_id = scheme_plans.plan_id JOIN schemes ON scheme_plans.scheme_id = schemes.scheme_id WHERE schemes.scheme_name = 'Sahyadri Focused Fund' AND scheme_plans.plan_type = 'Direct' AND scheme_plans.option_type = 'Growth' AND nav_history.nav_date BETWEEN '2023-10-01' AND '2026-08-31'), benchmark_nav AS (SELECT benchmark_values.value_date, benchmark_values.index_value FROM benchmark_values JOIN schemes ON benchmark_values.benchmark_id = schemes.benchmark_id WHERE schemes.scheme_name = 'Sahyadri Focused Fund' AND benchmark_values.value_date BETWEEN '2023-10-01' AND '2026-08-31'), start_nav AS (SELECT nav FROM fund_nav WHERE nav_date = (SELECT MIN(nav_date) FROM fund_nav)), end_nav AS (SELECT nav FROM fund_nav WHERE nav_date = (SELECT MAX(nav_date) FROM fund_nav)), start_benchmark AS (SELECT index_value FROM benchmark_nav WHERE value_date = (SELECT MIN(value_date) FROM benchmark_nav)), end_benchmark AS (SELECT index_value FROM benchmark_nav WHERE value_date = (SELECT MAX(value_date) FROM benchmark_nav)) SELECT ROUND((end_nav.nav / start_nav.nav - 1) * 100, 2) AS fund_return, ROUND((end_benchmark.index_value / start_benchmark.index_value - 1) * 100, 2) AS benchmark_return FROM start_nav, end_nav, start_benchmark, end_benchmark
result.commentary: After the manager change in October 2023, the Sahyadri Focused Fund showed a return of 44.87%, which is higher than the benchmark return of 31.34% for the same period. This indicates that the fund performed better than its benchmark after the manager change.

expected.question: Did the Focused Fund perform better after its manager changed in October 2023?
expected.notes: Manager changes on 3 Oct 2023; the fund beats its benchmark afterwards.
